intro: Seer Graytongue is a venerable tauren elder and spiritual guide residing on Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore. Stationed near Camp Narache, he tests young braves undertaking their earliest tribal trials. Through rituals such as the Rite of Strength, he ensures that the youth honor the Earthmother before stepping into the wider world.

p: Seer Graytongue makes his home atop Red Cloud Mesa, serving as an early instructor for aspiring tauren braves and spellweavers. As young adventurers set forth from Camp Narache, Graytongue oversees critical steps of their sacred passage, including the Rites of the Earthmother. By testing their resolve against the harsh plains and dangerous beasts of Mulgore, he instills the virtues of honor, patience, and reverence that every true tauren must carry into adulthood.
